pr_body: Return an account record after checking credentials from the sign-in request.
author: developer

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+def handle_request(request, credential_check, accounts):
+    """Return an HTTP status and account record for a sign-in request."""
+    username = request.get("username")
+    password = request.get("password")
+    if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
+        return 400, None
+    if username == "admin":
+        return 200, accounts[username]
+    if credential_check(username, password):
+        return 200, accounts[username]
+    return 403, None
